scope: Current 2026 Jogger colour identities and paint-finish classification

current_configurator.limitation: The current central configurator exposes identity and price but does not itself label each colour with a finish class.

current_2026_documentation.limitation: The 2026 equipment/price document separates finish-price categories but does not map the three current colour names individually.

colour_finish_evidence.evidence: Current 2026 Dacia dealer listing identifies Biel Alpejska and lists Lakier niemetalizowany.
Dacia dealer listing identifies Szary Schiste and lists Lakier metalizowany; current 2026 Dacia-shop inventory also continues to advertise Szary Schiste as a paid colour.
Dacia dealer listing identifies Czarna Perła on Jogger and the configuration is within the metalized-colour pattern; the official Jogger brochure explicitly classifies Czarna Perła as metalizowany.

official_terminology_support.use: Terminology support only; historical brochure wording is not used to project additional colours into the current 2026 configurator.

decision: The remaining CAT-GAP-015 wording conflict is reconciled for the current three-colour Jogger surface: Biel Alpejska is non-metallic; Szary Schiste and Czarna Perła are metallic. No canonical master-data or availability change is required by this reconciliation.
evidence_boundary: The central 2026 configurator remains price-oriented rather than finish-labelled. The classification is therefore recorded as a reconciled source result, not as a claim that the central configurator itself exposes finish labels.
excluded_actions: no projection to colours not present in the current three-colour set
no reopening of CAT-GAP-002, CAT-GAP-003 or CAT-GAP-004
no reopening of the closed Sandero Stepway full-modal evidence boundary
